name: k21-godown-date
prompt:
Noon inside a small distributor's godown in Nagpur: stacked Munchly cartons, each with its printed label on steel racks, a shaft of daylight from the open shutter. The distributor (the man in his mid-fifties with a trimmed grey moustache, a light blue checked short-sleeved shirt, reading glasses pushed up on his head, a steel kada on his right wrist) stands close in the foreground holding one Munchly carton, its printed label facing the camera tilted up in both hands, reading the small printed label panel on its side with a concerned frown. Medium close shot, 50 mm, the carton's printed label and his face sharp, the racks soft behind.

Photorealistic cinematic film still, live action, 35 mm, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural light, real skin and fabric. The cartons are kraft-brown with a sage-green band and the word MUNCHLY printed once in bold dark-green capital letters on each carton's side, nothing else written on them; the snack packets are plain solid orange, green and red foil packets with absolutely no printing, logos, brand names or pictures on them, not resembling any real brand; the Mango Drink packs are small plain yellow-orange tetra packs with a mango drawn on them and no lettering. The cartons are kraft-brown shipping cartons, each carrying one large printed product label exactly like the label in the reference photo: a white sticker with a maroon band reading MUNCHLY MASALA CHIPS (or MUNCHLY MANGO DRINK), the ingredients line, a boxed net quantity and MRP, a boxed BATCH NO, MFG and BEST BEFORE dates, the maker's address, the FSSAI mark, a barcode and a QR code, with a blue storage line at the foot; the label is crisp, straight and legible. The snack packets are Munchly's own orange chips packets exactly like the reference pack: an orange-to-red gradient with the white MUNCHLY wordmark on a green swoosh and 'Masala Chips' beneath; the Mango Drink packs are small yellow-orange tetra packs with a mango and the word Munchly. No other text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere. No number plate. No children.
